axisType.description: Whether this is x or y axis marker visualization

syncWithRelatedSeriesVisibility.description: Flag that indicates if the series and the related marker visibility will be synchronized. For example, if series is hidden then marker will be hidden too.

markerAxisValue.description: The value of the axis marker. Used to display a line/area shading on the chart on Y or X axis.

markerIdentifier.description: The identifier of the marker. Used to identify the marker in the chart and associate other series with it, if needed.

highlightOpacity.description: Opacity of the area shading when is highlighted.

title: A type to visualize axis markers in a chart as area shading.
name: UiSdlLineBarChartYAxisMarkerRangeShadingVisualization
